concerns.text: FR-014 (R² < 0.1 piecewise model test) has no dedicated task. T026 mentions testing piecewise regression but lacks explicit validation of the 'improvement in fit' output to metrics.json as required by FR-014 and Plan.md.

FR-005 (Multiple-comparison correction) and Plan.md mandate Bonferroni. T023b makes this 'configurable' (Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg), creating a gap where the spec's mandatory constraint is not enforced by a specific task.

FR-007 requires explicit citation of the NOAA SWPC definition document for severe storms. T033 identifies thresholds but lacks a specific task to inject the required citation URL into the output or documentation as mandated.

FR-006 requires recording the 'selected model type' in metrics.json when VIF > 5. T024 handles the logic but does not explicitly include a task to write the 'selected_model_type' key to results/metrics.json.

FR-012 requires measuring and reporting execution time and peak RAM. T041 mentions optimization, and T045 mentions profiling, but no task explicitly maps to writing the 'performance' block (time/RAM) to results/metrics.json as a distinct validation step.

FR-001 requires covering ≥10 years of historical data. T011 mentions '≥10 years' but lacks a specific validation task to verify the date range of the downloaded data against this requirement before proceeding.

FR-011 requires a strict time-series split (Train: 2010-2020, Test: 2021-2023). T032 enforces this, but there is no explicit task to validate that the dataset actually spans these dates and fails if it does not, as required by the Plan.md 'Pre-check' note.

T034b references 'typical galactic velocity dispersion scales' which is not in the spec/plan. The spec/plan explicitly defines the sweep as 900, 1000, 1100 km/s. This is a stale/incorrect description that needs correction to match the spec.

T023b allows switching between Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg. The Plan.md explicitly mandates Bonferroni. This task description contradicts the plan and needs to be corrected to reflect the fixed method.
